system.description:
A working network of floating fish exchanges, repair pontoons, and shared platforms where practical help, crew trust, and shifting moorings shape access and opportunity.

FAST PLAY

Opening: Open amid active work and let PCs offer practical help.

Access: Use Crew’s Word for passage, supplies, or leads; after failure, give a concrete task before another attempt.

Mutual Aid: Reward freely given help with Mutual Aid when PCs negotiate or navigate the Commons.

Complication: Use Shift the Moorings when platform movement creates a useful navigable timing problem.

Goal: Make working relationships shape access and opportunity without portraying the district as hostile.
system.notes: A Tier 2 social environment that makes working relationships shape passage, supplies, information, and navigation without treating Ballard Reach residents as default adversaries.
system.impulses: reward practical help, let crew trust shape access, turn moving platforms into timing complications, offer concrete work instead of hostility

system.description: A PC seeking passage, supplies, or information makes a Presence or Instinct Roll (14). Success with Hope secures fair terms and a useful lead. Success with Fear secures terms with one clearly stated small favor owed. On a failure, the crew offers a concrete task to complete before trying again; failure with Fear also delays access until that task is done.

system.description: Spend a Fear when platform movement matters. A pontoon separates; PCs crossing make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Failure marks 1 Stress and puts the PC on an adjacent secured craft; success keeps them on the intended platform. A successful Agility or Finesse Roll (14) reconnects the route; separation otherwise ends with the scene.
